sample_description: AEROXIDE P25 TiO2 powder as received (XRD ~80 mass% anatase + ~20 mass% rutile; ~30 nm particles)
notes: paper: "the anatase Eg mode (148 cm-1) of as-received P25 powder", above stoichiometric TiO2 (attributed to oxide-ion vacancies from Cl desorption); intermediate 700-850 °C positions only as stacked spectra in Fig. 2 (no numbers; not digitized); rutile bands skipped

sample_description: AEROXIDE P25 TiO2 powder heat-treated at 900 °C; mostly rutile, < 3 mass% anatase left (XRD)
conditions: heat-treated 900 °C 3 h in air (5 °C/min up, 2 °C/min down)
notes: paper: "Even at the highest heating temperature, 900 °C, an anatase peak can be still observed at 145 cm-1"; paper argues the band is mainly anatase Eg, not the weak rutile 143 band
